items.title: Charles McPherson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 9, 2024 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: You know Brian Lynch, really wonderful trumpet player, a good friend.

ctx.x: Well I’m traveling a lot. Let me see, I’ve got a record date that I’m going to do with Brian Lynch coming up in November. You know Brian Lynch, really wonderful trumpet player, a good friend. And let me see, I’ll probably do Smoke again at some point next year. Oh and I got a boat — a jazz cruise coming up in January. And I’m working quite a bit, I’m in Los Angeles in a couple of weeks from now, so I’ve been traveling quite a bit you know. So it’s been good. Since Covid kind of calmed down a bit I have been…
Well I really appreciate your time today, once again, and I wish I could shake hands but we’ll just you know —
